messages:
marco (Partnerships): Quick thread to line up HelmWorks marketplace listing + security integration checklist. Need SSO/SCIM, BYO-KMS handshake, secrets smoke tests, and embargo plan.

jamie (PM): Goals: 1) SAML test 2) SCIM user/group flows 3) KMS wrap/unwrap validation 4) secrets connector end-to-end 5) coordinated announcement embargo.

vera (HelmWorks): We will provide SAML metadata (staging link), SCIM staging endpoint, and a BYO-KMS gateway with attestation.

riley (Eng): Please share metadata via secure expiring link and include expected attributes (email, groups). Also send a service account for SCIM.

vera (HelmWorks): Link: https://staging.helmworks/files/saml-meta.xml (48h). Attributes: email, displayName, groups. SCIM token coming shortly.

casey (Security): Must have IP allowlist for SCIM callbacks, signed SCIM option, and HSM attestation (cert + firmware hash). Also need p50/p95/p99 KMS latency.

devin (SolutionsEng): Connector smoke plan: create user via SCIM, assign group, create secret, rotate, and fetch from Redwood runtime. I'll draft run commands and add retry/backoff for SCIM bulk.

riley (Eng): Run sample (staging):
```
curl -X POST https://scim.staging.helmworks/v2/Users -H 'Authorization: Bearer <scim>' -d "{\"userName\":\"rbx-test\",\"emails\":[{\"value\":\"eng@redwood.com\"}]}"
curl -X POST https://staging.helmworks/api/secrets -H 'Authorization: Bearer <api>' -d "{\"name\":\"rbx/test\",\"value\":\"s3cret\"}"
REDWOOD_SECRET=helmworks://rbx/test node scripts/fetch.js
```

jamie (PM): Tentative schedule: internal dry-run Mon, partner validation Tue, marketplace canary Wed. Legal needs embargo dates and MSA redline by Tue noon.

legal-bot: Reminder: upload latest MSA redline to /collab/partners/HelmWorks by Tue 11:00 PT or announcement will be delayed.

vera (HelmWorks): Will push attestation, telemetry (p50/p95/p99), and MSA redline by EOD tomorrow.

casey (Security): Two open issues: SCIM bulk throttling behavior and max concurrent KMS ops. Need those numbers to configure connector queues.

vera (HelmWorks): SCIM chunking + rate-limit headers supported. KMS staging metrics: p50=5ms, p95=18ms, p99=40ms, max concurrent 150. Telemetry coming.

marco (Partnerships): Action items: Vera upload metadata, attestation, telemetry, MSA (by EOD tomorrow). Devin/Riley finalize runbook and throttling (by Mon). Casey provide IP allowlist template (today). Jamie draft embargo + announcement outline (by Mon).

marco (Partnerships): I'll schedule a 30-min smoke test call Tue 09:00 PT. Keep marketing copy internal until legal sign-off.

jamie (PM): Sending invite now.

riley (Eng): I'll be on the call with the staging harness.

vera (HelmWorks): We'll join with infra lead.

casey (Security): I'll sign off on checklist during the call.

devin (SolutionsEng): I'll attach test scripts to the invite.

marco (Partnerships): Thanks team.
